projects.title: Mare FEst: Mare Fertility Estimation
projects.description: Bachelor's Degree Thesis: Developed segmentation models and processing pipeline to analyze mare uterine biopsies, leading to 2025 IBERAMIA Springer publication.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{Mare FEst (Thesis Project):} Developed segmentation models and an image processing pipeline for endometrial biopsy analysis, , directly establishing the research foundation for the published Springer paper. \href{https://github.com/Peregalli/MareFEst}{[GitHub]} \textbar{} \href{https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12008/43668}{[Thesis]}

projects.title: Kalman VAE: Disentangled Recognition & Dynamics
projects.description: Reimplementation of 'A Disentangled Recognition and Nonlinear Dynamics Model for Unsupervised Learning'. Analyzing VAE algorithm capacity limits.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{Kalman VAE (MVA Project):} Reimplemented \textit{"A Disentangled Recognition and Nonlinear Dynamics Model for Unsupervised Learning"} to evaluate latent disentanglement, variational inference bounds, and nonlinear dynamics in PyTorch.

projects.title: Holographic Embeddings of Knowledge Graphs
projects.description: Based on 'Holographic Embeddings of Knowledge Graphs'. Studying model capacity in larger datasets and proposing fair evaluation alternatives.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{Knowledge Graph Embeddings (MVA Project):} Investigated Holographic Embeddings (HolE) for relational learning; benchmarked representation capacity on large-scale datasets and formulated fair evaluation metrics.

projects.title: Detection of Re-captured Images from a Monitor
projects.description: Algorithm implementation capable of recognizing whether an image was taken from a real-life scene or an LCD monitor.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{Recaptured Image Forensics:} Developed spatial-frequency and moir\'{e} pattern analysis algorithms to reliably classify whether an image was captured from a physical scene versus an LCD display.

projects.title: Physical Simulation of 3D Gaussian Splats
projects.description: Estimated internal volumetric filling, material properties, and structural parameters of 3D Gaussian Splats to generate physical simulations of reconstructed objects.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{Physical Simulation of 3D Gaussian Splats:} Researched volumetric internal filling and physical material estimation for 3D GS to enable high-fidelity real-time physics simulations.

projects.title: LLM Reasoning for Machine Translation
projects.description: Utilized large language models to improve the accuracy and fluency of machine translation systems.
projects.latex: \item \textbf{LLM Reasoning for Machine Translation:} Finetuning LLM (gemma-3-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B) and evaluating chain of thought reasoning to enhance machine translation accuracy.
